title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator in Blackpool!

upto 30k

Monday to Friday

Are you an organised and detail-oriented professional with a passion for sales and administration? Our client, a leading organisation in the Manufacturing & Production sector, is seeking a dynamic Sales Administrator to join their vibrant team in Blackpool. This is a fantastic opportunity for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and are eager to contribute to the success of a growing company.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Sales Administrator, you will play a crucial role in supporting the sales team and ensuring smooth operations. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

Providing administrative support to the sales team, including managing schedules and coordinating meetings.
Processing sales orders and ensuring timely delivery to customers.
Maintaining accurate sales records and databases.
Assisting in preparing sales reports and presentations.
Liaising with customers to address inquiries and provide exceptional service.
Collaborating with other departments to streamline processes and enhance efficiency.

What Our Client Offers:

A permanent contract with a competitive salary package.
Opportunities for professional development and growth within the organisation.
A supportive and friendly work environment where team collaboration is valued.
Engaging company culture with team-building activities and events.
Convenient location in Blackpool with easy access to public transport.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

Our client is looking for a proactive individual who possesses the following qualifications and skills:

Previous experience in a sales administration or similar role within the Manufacturing & Production industry.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
A positive attitude and a customer-focused mindset.

Why Choose a Career with Our Client?

Joining this organisation means becoming part of a forward-thinking company that values innovation and teamwork. The employer is committed to fostering a culture of excellence and providing employees with the tools they need to succeed. If you're ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to a thriving organisation, this is the perfect opportunity!

Take the leap and embrace a rewarding career as a Sales Administrator with our client in Blackpool! Your next adventure awaits-apply today!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.
